review: 702.113b-1: decisions listed two separate casts and variant normal_cast_no_land changed two facts from the base (no Island and the cost paid); rebuilt with no land in the setup, a single {U} cast as base and the awaken-cost payment as the one-fact variant; Island dropped.

scenarios.title: A spell cast for its awaken cost animates the target land with counters

setup.notes: Clutch of Currents costs {U} and has awaken 3 with cost {4}{U}.

decisions: A casts Clutch of Currents for its awaken cost {4}{U}, tapping all five Islands, targeting B's Grizzly Bears and the first Island.
Both players pass; Clutch of Currents resolves.

variants.label: awaken_paid
variants.expected: Clutch of Currents resolves. Grizzly Bears returns to B's hand. The targeted Island gets three +1/+1 counters and is a 3/3 Elemental land creature with haste. Clutch of Currents goes to A's graveyard.

variants.label: normal_cast
variants.delta: A casts Clutch of Currents for its mana cost {U}, tapping one Island, with Grizzly Bears as its only target.
variants.expected: Clutch of Currents resolves. Grizzly Bears returns to B's hand. All five Islands are plain lands with no counters and none is a creature.

operation.unclassifiable: choice: A casts for the mana cost instead of the awaken cost

detector.outcome: A spell cast with an awaken cost resolves and puts +1/+1 counters on a target land its controller controls.
detector.near_miss: A resolution of an awaken line that puts no counters on a land.

scenarios.title: The awaken land target is required only when the awaken cost is paid

setup.notes: A controls no land. Its four mana artifacts together produce exactly five mana, one of it blue ({U} from Mox Sapphire, {C}{C} from Sol Ring, {C} each from Mind Stone and Thought Vessel). Clutch of Currents costs {U} and has awaken 3 with cost {4}{U}.

decisions: A casts Clutch of Currents paying only its mana cost {U} with Mox Sapphire, choosing Grizzly Bears as its target; the engine's verdict and the targets required are read.

variants.label: normal_cast_no_land
variants.expected: Casting for {U} is legal with Grizzly Bears as its only target; no land target is chosen or required although A controls no land.

variants.label: awaken_no_land
variants.delta: A pays the awaken cost {4}{U} with all four mana artifacts instead of the mana cost {U}.
variants.expected: Casting for the awaken cost is illegal: the awaken ability then requires a target land A controls and A controls none.

operation.unclassifiable: choice: A pays the awaken cost instead of the mana cost

detector.outcome: A candidate for a card with awaken has a legal target without needing a land (cast for its mana cost, awaken unused).
detector.near_miss: A candidate for a card with awaken that has no legal target.
